Uses a lossless audio codec, if one is available for the codec. If you set`audioCodec`, it takes priority over `preferLossless`.

## CLI flag

Use `--prefer-lossless` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                             | Flag                |
| --------------------------------------------------- | ------------------- |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render) | `--prefer-lossless` |

| Reference                                                                        | Name                              |

| [`renderMediaOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/rendermediaoncloudrun#preferlossless) | `preferLossless`                  |
| [Configuration file](/docs/config#setpreferlosslessaudio)                        | `Config.setPreferLosslessAudio()` |
